verdict.rationale: The docs give Claude Code-specific installation (plugin marketplace add/install, or copying into `.claude/skills/`). The only cross-agent path is a generic fallback: paste a single SKILL.md into any chat to run it as a mode. There are no per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor or other agents. Missing for 10: dedicated install instructions for Codex, Cursor and other harnesses; a way to install the whole collection rather than one SKILL.md into non-Claude agents; hands-on corroboration that it runs in other agents.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: No Claude Code at all? Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
